Youth robotics & AI · Cameroon and the United States

Every child deserves the chance to build the future.

AfroBot teaches young people to design, build and program robots and AI, in classrooms in Cameroon and communities across the United States.

Find a program Sponsor a student

3,200EDUCARE School Bamenda pupils, ages 8–15, since June 2023
2022classes since November 2022
30kids in the 2024 McKinney pilot
Our mission

Kids in Cameroon have been building and coding robots since November 2022. A pilot in McKinney, Texas, followed in 2024.

Programs

A pathway for every age

Children start where they are and grow with us, from their first hands-on build to leading a competition team.

See the programs

Ages 6–9

Discover

First builds by hand. Children learn how machines move and work in small teams.

Explore Discover
Ages 9–12

Build

Larger builds, circuits and first code. Teams carry a project from idea to working robot.

Explore Build
Ages 13–17

Innovate · Compete · Advance

AI-powered humanoid robots, competition seasons, and older students mentoring younger teams.

Explore the teen track
